purpose: Classify AU/AG option K-line contract-days by pre-outcome OHLCV, turnover, open-interest, timestamp-continuity and contract-identity evidence only.

boundary_correction.rationale: The bare-K PA/Feitian research lane consumes naked option premium K-lines. Bid/ask and contract delta are absent rather than proxied. Exact expiry/DTE may be recorded only when explicit and is not an eligibility gate.

source_context.external_context_role: Interpret source layout and quality vocabulary only; it may not alter this contract's frozen thresholds.
source_context.threshold_basis: Predeclared Xiao bare-K liquidity floors of session volume 100 and open interest 500, augmented with deterministic turnover and timestamp-continuity integrity gates; no outcomes were inspected.

window.source_timestamp_interpretation: timezone-naive Asia/Shanghai period-end labels, as declared by the committed strategy migration note
window.event_time_rule: For a contract-local-date unit, read only source rows whose interpreted local timestamp is less than or equal to that unit's 15:00:00 cutoff. Rows after the cutoff and rows after the frozen last date are forbidden.

unit.name: contract_local_date_cadence
unit.eligible_population: Every parsed AU/AG option contract file with at least one row on a local date in the frozen window; no contract, strike, month or side may be selected using later premium paths or outcomes.

quality_contract.coherent_ohlc: high >= max(open, close, low) and low <= min(open, close, high)

continuity_window.expected_grid: cadence-aligned period-end labels including both endpoints

liquidity_floors_at_cutoff.session_definition: same local calendar date, timestamp <= inclusive cutoff

quality_contract.eligibility_rule: A unit is eligible if and only if identity, schema, timestamp, OHLC, exact-cutoff, continuity, volume, turnover and open-interest requirements all pass.

evidence_output.source_references: relative public-safe aliases and SHA-256 aggregate digests only

promotion.next_gate: After this eligibility evidence is verified, separately freeze a premium-path research protocol using only eligible bare-K units; a faithful frozen DD-line remains required for faithful Feitian claims.
